'''Snoo''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Snoo was present at the [[Rii Jenks Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]]. There, he encountered a group of off-world individuals who had been hired to recover the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R4-W9]], which had been stolen by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bandin Dobah]]. In return for a small fee, Snoo agreed to provide the off-worlders with information regarding Dobah and his activities.
